tools.name: find_answer
tools.description: Searches Bitcoin Super's published answers and returns up to five, word for word as the site publishes them, best first, each with its page url. Only approved published content is returned; an empty answers list means no published answer matches. Deterministic; no model.

tools.name: calculate_smsf_scenario
tools.description: Runs the Bitcoin Super SMSF scenario model: Managed Superfund versus Bitcoin Super tracks with contributions, Transfer Balance Cap split, and minimum pension drawdowns. Optional Advanced fields cover inflation and spending coverage (web v2.2). Outputs are illustrations under published assumptions on

tools.name: prepare_enquiry
tools.description: Returns the gold-form context for a free Bitcoin SMSF consultation on Bitcoin Super: referrer bitcoinsuper.io (HubSpot enum), acquisition source, and where a person completes the form. It does not fill personal fields and does not submit anything. Only a person submits. The lead is directed to Andy;

tools.name: read_assumptions
tools.description: Returns the published Bitcoin Super calculator constants, presets, exclusions summary, and methodology label. Figures are dated site claims pending ATO revalidation. Not advice.

tools.name: handoff_tba
tools.description: Returns The Bitcoin Adviser URLs for services Bitcoin Super does not implement: SMSF audit guide, EOFY checklist, Collaborative Security, historical valuation, and estate continuity. Bitcoin Super remains the educational publisher; TBA delivers those services.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "calculate_smsf_scenario" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_answer · Private data: calculate_smsf_scenario · Public sink: prepare_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_answer · Private data: calculate_smsf_scenario · Public sink: prepare_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
